events.title: Anime and Manga Seichi Expo

events.summary: Celebrate anime and manga pilgrimage sites with regional booths, live music stages, and craft workshops.

events.title: Tokyo Music Evening Yube
events.summary: Enjoy an open-air classical saxophone concert featuring arrangements of popular orchestral and ballet pieces.

events.title: Nakaikebukuro Park Flea Market
events.summary: Browse second-hand goods, handmade crafts, and participate in workshop activities at the park.

events.title: Ikebukuro Global Ring Music Festival

events.summary: Students perform a cappella music and brass band concerts across open-air stages and public spaces.

events.title: Komagome Cultural Festival
events.summary: Local community members showcase their cultural activities and creative achievements through various displays.

events.title: IKE-Biz Festa
events.summary: Visitors enjoy family concerts, local specialty product sales, and interactive workshops for all ages.

events.title: Somei Yoshino Sakura Village Autumn Festival
events.summary: Celebrate the birthplace of the Somei Yoshino cherry blossom with local product exhibitions and stage performances.

events.title: Toshima Animal Welfare Festival
events.summary: Enjoy pet-friendly games, pet care consultation booths, and information about community cat activities.

events.title: Welfare and Health Festival

events.summary: Enjoy food stalls, hands-on health checks, stage performances, and prize draws at this community welfare event.

events.title: Lifestyle Expo in Toshima
events.summary: Explore community activities, short lectures, experience booths, and a free meal tasting for older adults.

events.title: Naka-Ikebukuro Park Flea Market
events.summary: Browse handmade goods, crafts, and second-hand items at this outdoor park flea market and workshop event.
